title: Returns & Refunds Policy
body:
We want you to be confident in what you order from Jumbo Sales. This policy explains how we handle returns, exchanges and refunds for hardware and construction materials.

Damaged or Incorrect Items. If an item arrives damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered, contact us within 48 hours of delivery via WhatsApp or phone, with photos of the item where possible. We will arrange a replacement, exchange, or refund depending on the situation and product availability.

Change of Mind. Because many of our products (mabati cut to length, made-to-order steel sizes, and similar) are supplied specifically for your order, we are generally not able to accept returns for change of mind once materials have been cut, fabricated, or dispatched to your specification. Standard, unmodified stock items may be eligible for return within 7 days of delivery, subject to the item being unused and in its original condition — confirm eligibility with us before returning any item.

Water Tanks. Water tanks may only be returned if they are unused, undamaged, and reported as unsuitable within 48 hours of delivery. Tanks that have been installed, filled, or modified are not eligible for return.

How to Request a Return. Contact us on WhatsApp or by phone with your order details, the reason for the return, and photos if the item is damaged or incorrect. We will confirm next steps, which may include collection, exchange, or refund arrangements.

Refunds. Where a refund is agreed, it will be processed using the same payment method used for the original order, unless another method is agreed with you directly. Refund timelines depend on the payment method used.

Non-Returnable Items. Items that have been cut, fabricated, installed, or custom-ordered to your specification cannot be returned unless found to be defective or incorrectly supplied.

Contact. For any return, exchange or refund request, reach us via the phone, WhatsApp or email listed on our Contact page — we aim to resolve issues quickly and fairly.
